questions.question: In April 2025, which of the following organisations launched the innovative drug 'Fexuclue' in India for the treatment of Erosive Esophagitis?
questions.solution:

• The introduction of **Fexuclue** marked a significant advancement in the treatment options for digestive disorders, particularly for patients suffering from this chronic condition.
 
• **Erosive Esophagitis** is commonly associated with symptoms such as heartburn and acid reflux and can lead to complications like ulcers and strictures if left untreated.
 
• The launch of such innovative drugs demonstrates **Sun Pharmaceutical Industries’** commitment to addressing unmet medical needs and improving patient care.
 
• Sun Pharma is headquartered in **Mumbai, India**, and operates in **over 100 countries**, with a strong focus on research and development.
 
• The company is known for its expertise in **specialty generics**, branded generics, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs).

 __

• The company specializes in **innovative vaccines and bio-therapeutics**.
 
• It is headquartered in **Hyderabad, Telangana**.
 
 
 
• **Serum Institute of India**__

• The company is known for its work in **generic medicines, biosimilars, and over-the-counter drugs**.

questions.question: Where is the AmazonFACE project — the world’s first large-scale rainforest CO₂ enrichment experiment — located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Manaus, Brazil**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Scientists in Brazil’s Amazon rainforest have developed AmazonFACE, a first-of-its-kind experiment designed to study how the Amazon will respond to rising CO₂ levels in the coming decades.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The experiment uses towers to release carbon dioxide into the forest canopy to simulate future atmospheric conditions.
 
• **Location:** Near Manaus, Brazil, deep within the Amazon rainforest.
 
• **Full Form:** AmazonFACE – Free-Air CO₂ Enrichment.
 
• **Setup:** Six tower rings, each surrounding 50–70 mature trees.
 
• **Objective:** To measure how tropical forests absorb CO₂, produce oxygen, and adapt to climate change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Lead Institutions:** INPA (National Institute for Amazon Research) and Universidade Estadual de Campinas.
 
• **Support:** Funded jointly by Brazil and the United Kingdom.
 
• **Technology:** Sensors record forest response data every 10 minutes.
 
• **Significance:** Provides key insights into how the Amazon — the “lungs of the Earth” — will cope with rising CO₂ levels by 2050–2060.

questions.question: Which indigenous technology is incorporated for spacecraft navigation in the SpaDeX mission in 2025?

options.text: GNSS-based Relative Orbit Determination and Propagation (RODP) processor
Al-driven self-learning Orbit Relative Orbit Determination and Propagation (RODP) processor

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**GNSS-based Relative Orbit Determination and Propagation (RODP) processor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GNSS** stands for **Global Navigation Satellite System**, which includes systems like GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou.
 
• The **Relative Orbit Determination and Propagation (RODP) processor** is an indigenous technology designed for precise navigation and orbit calculation in spacecraft.
 
• This technology utilizes **GNSS signals** to determine the relative position and velocity of spacecraft.
 
• In the SpaDeX mission, the GNSS-based RODP processor enhances the spacecraft's **autonomous navigation capabilities** without requiring ground-based intervention.
 
• By integrating GNSS signals with the RODP processor, the SpaDeX mission achieves **accurate orbit determination and prediction**, critical for the satellite's functionality and mission success.
 
• GNSS-based navigation is widely used in space missions due to its **high precision, reliability, and global accessibility**.
 
• The incorporation of this technology in the SpaDeX mission aligns with India’s focus on developing **indigenous space technologies** to reduce reliance on external systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Magnetosphere scanning system**__

 __
 
• This system is used to study the **magnetic field** surrounding a planet or celestial body.
 
• It plays a critical role in understanding the **interaction between solar winds and planetary magnetic fields**.
 
• While highly useful in planetary exploration missions, it does not serve the purpose of spacecraft navigation like GNSS-based systems.
 
 
 
• **AI-driven self-learning Orbit Relative Orbit Determination and Propagation (RODP) processor**__
 __
 
• Though promising as a future technology, an **AI-driven self-learning RODP processor** is still under development and testing for space missions.
 
• Such systems aim to use **machine learning algorithms** for autonomous navigation but are not yet fully deployed in operational missions.
 
 
 
• **Hybrid rocket propulsion**__
 
 
• **Hybrid rocket propulsion** combines solid and liquid propellants for efficient thrust generation.
 
• This technology is related to the **propulsion system** of spacecraft, not navigation systems.
 
• It is typically used for launching spacecraft or satellites, ensuring better control over thrust and fuel efficiency.

questions.question: An international team of scientists has discovered a new phase of matter called the Time Rondeau Crystal (TRC). What distinguishes a Time Rondeau Crystal (TRC) from a time crystal?

options.text: It shows only order in time
It exhibits both order and randomness in time
It repeats its pattern in space
It is made of a fixed material like diamond

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It exhibits both order and randomness in time.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **A new phase of matter, the Time Rondeau Crystal (TRC), has been discovered, exhibiting both order and randomness in time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Time Rondeau Crystal (TRC) shows both regular patterns (order) and irregular behavior (randomness) over time.**
 
• **It is a new phase of matter, similar to a time crystal, but with a significant difference of randomness between repetitions.**
 
• **TRC was created using carbon-13 atoms in a diamond and controlling their spins with microwave pulses at varying intervals.**
 
• **The discovery of TRC opens new possibilities in quantum technology, information storage, and scientific research.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Time Crystal__

 __
 
• A system that repeats its motion at fixed time intervals
 
• Shows regular behavior at equal time intervals, similar to pushing a swing
 
 
 
• Quantum Technology and TRC__
 __
 
• TRC can help design new quantum sensors that detect time patterns
 
• It may also be used for information storage based on the timing of its repeating patterns
 
 
 
• Scientific Impact__
 
 
• TRC helps understand how order and randomness can coexist in time
 
• It opens new ways to study materials and quantum systems

questions.question: What is the spatial resolution of the Bharat Forecasting System (BFS) launched in May 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**6 kilometres**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bharat Forecasting System (BFS)** launched in **May 2025** is a high-resolution weather forecasting model designed for India.
 
• The BFS has a spatial resolution of **6 kilometres**, which allows for detailed and accurate predictions of weather patterns across various regions in India.
 
• This advanced resolution enhances the ability to forecast localized weather events such as **thunderstorms, heavy rainfall, or cyclones**, thereby improving disaster preparedness.
 
• The BFS is part of India's ongoing efforts to modernize its meteorological capabilities, ensuring more precise data collection and prediction systems.
 
• The system is expected to benefit sectors such as **agriculture, transportation, disaster management**, and energy by providing timely and accurate weather forecasts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Spatial Resolution in Weather Forecasting Models:**

 
 
• Spatial resolution refers to the size of the grid used in weather prediction models. A resolution of **6 kilometres** means each grid cell covers an area of 6 km x 6 km.
 
• Higher resolutions, like 6 kilometres, allow for more localized and detailed weather predictions compared to coarser resolutions such as 12 or 10 kilometres.
 
• This is especially important in a geographically diverse country like India, where weather conditions can vary significantly over short distances.
 
 
 
• **Applications of BFS:**
 
 
• The Bharat Forecasting System will aid in **agricultural planning**, enabling farmers to make informed decisions regarding planting, irrigation, and harvesting.
 
• It will improve **disaster management** by providing accurate forecasts of cyclones, floods, and other extreme weather events.
 
• It is expected to support sectors like **aviation and shipping** by offering precise weather data crucial for navigation and safety.
 
• The BFS will also contribute to **renewable energy projects** by predicting weather conditions that affect solar and wind energy generation.
 
 
 
• **Comparison of Spatial Resolutions:**
 
 
• **10 kilometres:** Typically used in older models, suitable for large-scale weather patterns but less effective for localized events.
 
• **3 kilometres:** Ultra-high resolution, often used for specific regions or research purposes but computationally intensive.
 
• **12 kilometres:** Standard resolution for global models, balancing computational efficiency and detail.
 
• **6 kilometres:** Ideal for regional forecasting, offering a balance between detail and computational efficiency.
 
 
 
• **India's Meteorological Advancements:**
 
 
• The BFS is part of India's initiative to leverage **advanced technology** for weather forecasting, enhancing the accuracy and reliability of predictions.
 
• It complements other systems like the **Doppler Weather Radar network**, satellite-based observations, and climate models.
 
• These advancements align with India's commitment to improving its **climate resilience** and disaster preparedness.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Bharat Forecasting System's Contribution:**

 
 
• It represents a significant upgrade in India's meteorological infrastructure, contributing to better **weather prediction accuracy**.
 
• The BFS supports India's goals under international agreements like the **Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction**.
 
• It helps integrate weather forecasting into various sectors, boosting **economic efficiency** and minimizing losses due to unforeseen weather events.

questions.question: Announced in 2025, what type of engine is ISRO designing for Next Generation Launch Vehicle (NGLV)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**LOX-Methane engine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)** announced plans in **2025** to develop a new generation of launch vehicle (NGLV) equipped with **LOX-Methane engines**.
 
• The development of **LOX-Methane engines** is part of ISRO’s efforts to create more efficient, reusable, and environmentally friendly rocket propulsion systems for future space missions.
 
• **LOX-Methane engines** use **liquid oxygen (LOX)** as an oxidizer and **methane** as a fuel, which is a more sustainable and cleaner alternative compared to traditional fuels like hydrazine or RP-1 (kerosene).
 
• These engines are designed to cater to the increasing demand for launching heavy payloads into orbit, which aligns with ISRO’s vision for the next-generation space exploration and satellite deployment.
 
• The **LOX-Methane combination** also allows potential reuse of rockets, as methane burns cleanly and minimizes residue buildup within the engine, facilitating refurbishment for multiple launches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **LOX-Methane Engines:**

 
 
• **Liquid Oxygen (LOX):** LOX is used as an oxidizer in rocket propulsion systems due to its high efficiency and ability to produce large thrust when combined with fuels.
 
• **Methane:** Methane is a clean-burning fuel that reduces engine residue, making it suitable for reusable rocket systems. It is also easier to store and handle compared to hydrogen.
 
• **Advantages:** LOX-Methane engines are more environmentally friendly, cost-effective, and offer higher efficiency for deep-space missions, as methane can be sourced from Martian soil for refueling purposes.
 
 
 
• **ISRO’s Next Generation Launch Vehicle (NGLV):**
 
 
• ISRO is focusing on developing the NGLV to replace its current workhorse launch vehicle, the GSLV Mk III, for enhanced payload capacity and greater reusability.
 
• **Applications:** NGLV is expected to support diverse missions, including launching communication satellites, interplanetary exploration, and large-scale space missions.
 
• **Reusable Design:** NGLV will incorporate reusable technology to reduce launch costs and increase competitiveness in the global space market.
 
 
 
• **Other Propulsion Systems:**
 
 
• **LOX-Kerosene Engines:** These engines are widely used in rockets such as SpaceX’s Falcon series but are less efficient and less environmentally friendly compared to LOX-Methane engines.
 
• **Hydrogen-Fueled Engines:** Hydrogen engines offer high efficiency but come with storage and handling challenges due to hydrogen’s cryogenic properties.
 
• **Cryogenic Solid Fuel Engines:** These engines are used for specific applications but lack the reusability and efficiency offered by LOX-Methane systems.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Space agencies like SpaceX and Blue Origin are already leveraging LOX-Methane engines for their reusable rocket programs, indicating the growing trend towards adopting this technology globally.
 
• ISRO’s development of LOX-Methane engines will align India with cutting-edge advancements in space propulsion systems and enhance its competitive edge in space exploration.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Why LOX-Methane?**

 
 
• **Clean Combustion:** Methane burns cleaner than kerosene and hydrogen, reducing engine maintenance and enabling reuse.
 
• **Storage Benefits:** Methane is easier to store as it does not need extremely low temperatures like hydrogen.
 
• **Space Exploration:** Methane can be produced on Mars using in-situ resource utilization, supporting long-term interplanetary missions.
 
• **Global Adoption:** Leading companies like SpaceX use LOX-Methane engines, showcasing their reliability and efficiency for modern space missions.
 
 
 
• **ISRO’s Contribution:**
 
 
• ISRO has consistently invested in advanced propulsion systems to enhance India’s capabilities in space exploration and satellite deployment.
 
• The NGLV project with LOX-Methane engines represents a significant step forward in making India self-reliant in next-gen space technology.

questions.question: Which of the following claims made about the gene-edited rice variety DRR Rice 100 (Kamala) was not supported by the analysis of ICAR’s field trial data?

options.text: It matured 20 days earlier than its parent variety
It yielded 17% higher than its parent variety

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It matured 20 days earlier than its parent variety.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Analysis of ICAR data revealed that claims regarding the gene-edited rice varieties DRR Rice 100 (Kamala) and Pusa DST Rice 1 were inconsistent with actual trial performance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **ICAR trial data showed that DRR Rice 100 (Kamala) did not mature 20 days earlier than its parent BPT 5204 (Samba Mahsuri).**
 
• **The mean difference in flowering time between Kamala and its parent was only 3 days (101 vs 104 days).**
 
• **In some zones, Kamala actually took 8–9 days longer to flower than its parent variety.**
 
• **No evidence was found in the AICRPR annual reports supporting claims of a 20-day earlier maturity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **DRR Rice 100 (Kamala)**__

 __
 
• Developed by ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR), Hyderabad.
 
• Derived from the popular variety **BPT 5204 (Samba Mahsuri)**.
 
• Claimed to yield 17% higher and mature 20 days earlier, saving water and fertilizers.
 
 
 
• **Pusa DST Rice 1**__
 __
 
• Developed by ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), New Delhi.
 
• Derived from **MTU 1010 (Cotton Dora Sannalu)**.
 
• Claimed 30% higher yield and better salinity tolerance, but data showed no consistent advantage.
 
 
 
• **CRISPR-Cas9 Technology**__
 
 
• A genome-editing tool used to modify specific DNA sequences with precision.
 
• Criticized by experts for potential risks and dependence on multinational seed corporations.
 
• Coalition for a GM-Free India called for an independent review of ICAR’s trial data and methodology.

questions.question: Which species is potentially recognized as a distinct species within the Canis genus for the first time by the IUCN?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian wolf.**__

__
 
• The **Indian wolf (Canis lupus pallipes)** has been evaluated separately by the IUCN for the first time, with potential recognition as a distinct species within the **Canis genus.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian wolf is primarily found in **India and Pakistan**, with its range south of the Himalayas.
 
• Its population is concentrated in **central, western, and northern India**, with major populations in states like Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan.
 
• It faces significant threats due to **habitat loss**, **persecution**, and **human-wildlife conflict**, leading to its classification as **Vulnerable** on the IUCN Red List.
 
• The Indian wolf is one of the most **ancient wolf lineages**, and the IUCN’s evaluation may pave the way for greater conservation efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Habitat Range**__: Indian wolves are mainly found across **sixteen states** of India, including Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Karnataka.
 
• __**Protection Status**__: The Indian wolf is listed as **Vulnerable** on the IUCN Red List, reflecting its declining population.
 
• __**Conservation Challenges**__: The species faces threats from **human-wildlife conflict**, **poaching**, and the ongoing **loss of its natural habitat**.
 
• __**Distinct Species Status**__: The IUCN’s recognition of the Indian wolf as potentially distinct from other Canis species could have significant implications for its conservation status and strategies.

questions.question: What unique feature does the VIKRAM3201 microprocessor, developed by ISRO's Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre and Semiconductor Laboratory (SCL), Chandigarh in 2025, support?

options.text: Real-time GPS computation and Ada language support
Floating-point computation and Ada language support

__
 
• The **VIKRAM3201 microprocessor** is a cutting-edge chip developed by the **Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC)** in collaboration with the **Semiconductor Laboratory (SCL), Chandigarh**, under the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• One of its unique features is its ability to perform **floating-point computations**, which are essential for complex scientific, engineering, and space-related calculations.
 
• The microprocessor supports the **Ada programming language**, which is widely used in high-integrity and safety-critical applications like aerospace systems.
 
• The **floating-point computation** capability allows the processor to handle real numbers and perform arithmetic operations with high precision, critical for tasks such as **orbit calculations** and **trajectory analysis** in space missions.
 
• The inclusion of **Ada language support** ensures that the processor adheres to high standards of **reliability, maintainability, and security**, which are vital in mission-critical systems.
 
• This development reflects ISRO’s commitment to achieving **self-reliance** in advanced semiconductor technologies, reducing dependency on foreign processors for space applications.

questions.question: What is the main characteristic of the asteroid 2025 PN7 that makes it unique?

options.text: It orbits Earth like the Moon
It travels around the Sun in an orbit nearly identical to Earth’s
It is gravitationally bound to Earth
It is classified as a planet

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It travels around the Sun in an orbit nearly identical to Earth’s.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **2025 PN7 is a small asteroid that travels around the Sun in almost the same orbit as Earth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• It was discovered by astronomers at the University of Hawaii and confirmed by NASA.
 
• Although it is not a real moon, its path makes it appear to follow Earth through space.
 
• It has been moving near Earth’s orbit for almost 60 years and may continue doing so until around 2083.
 
• **The asteroid 2025 PN7 is classified as a "quasi-moon" due to its orbit around the Sun that closely mirrors Earth’s orbit.**
 
• **At its closest point, 2025 PN7 is about 4 million kilometres from Earth, much farther than the Moon.**
 
• **This asteroid is not gravitationally bound to Earth and will eventually drift away into deep space.**
 
• **NASA scientists study quasi-moons like 2025 PN7 to understand asteroid movements and orbital mechanics within the solar system.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Quasi-Moon__

 __
 
• A small celestial body that follows a path similar to Earth's orbit but is not gravitationally bound to Earth.
 
 
 
• NASA__
 __
 
• NASA is the United States government agency responsible for the civilian space program and aeronautics research.
 
 
 
• Orbit__
 __
 
• The curved path of a celestial object around a star, planet, or moon, due to the gravitational attraction between them.
 
 
 
• Asteroid__
 
 
• A small rocky body orbiting the Sun, typically found in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.

questions.question: Which space mission launched by NASA aims to map the heliosphere’s boundary, track energetic particles, and enhance space weather forecasting?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe (IMAP).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NASA launched the Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe (IMAP)__ to map the heliosphere’s boundary and enhance space weather forecasting.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The mission explores the heliosphere__, the Sun’s protective bubble, and its interaction with interstellar space.**
 
• **IMAP is positioned at the __Earth-Sun Lagrange Point 1 (L1)__ to provide an optimal vantage point for observation.**
 
• **The spacecraft uses __10 instruments__ to study solar wind, energetic particles, magnetic fields, and cosmic remnants.**
 
• **The mission aims to uncover how solar particles are energized and how the heliosphere shields Earth from galactic radiation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Heliosphere**__

 __
 
• The bubble of charged particles and magnetic fields surrounding the Sun and the solar system.
 
• Protects Earth from galactic cosmic radiation.
 
 
 
• **Lagrange Point L1**__
 __
 
• A point in space where the gravitational forces of the Earth and Sun balance the centripetal force felt by a satellite.
 
• Positioned about 1.5 million kilometers from Earth, ideal for observing solar wind and space weather.
 
 
 
• **Space Weather Forecasting**__
 __
 
• IMAP provides real-time data to monitor and predict space weather, which is crucial for protecting astronauts and Earth-based technologies.
 
 
 
• **IMAP's Scientific Goals**__
 
 
• Study solar wind interactions with interstellar medium.
 
• Understand cosmic radiation effects and planetary habitability.

questions.question: Where was the new marine species Apterichtus kanniyakumari discovered?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Colachel coast, Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **A new marine species named Apterichtus kanniyakumari was discovered off the Colachel coast in Tamil Nadu by researchers from the National Bureau of Fish Genetic Resources (NBFGR).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The species belongs to the genus Apterichtus, commonly known as finless snake eels, and adds to India’s coastal biodiversity.**
 
• **Apterichtus kanniyakumari is visually distinct with a golden-yellow body, pale white ventral head, yellow lines on the lower jaw, and three black blotches.**
 
• **Genetic analysis using the mitochondrial CO1 gene confirmed that this species forms a distinct clade, separate from its closest relative Apterichtus nanjilnaduensis.**
 
• **Finless snake eels of family Ophichthidae are adapted to sandy seabed habitats, exhibiting backward burrowing behavior and cryptic lifestyles, often at depths up to 800 meters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __
 
• Discovered by NBFGR during marine biodiversity studies near Colachel, a coastal town in Kanniyakumari district, Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• Naming__
 __
 
• The species is named after Kanniyakumari district, India’s southernmost district, to honor the location of its discovery.
 
 
 
• Habitat and Adaptations__
 __
 
• Finless snake eels inhabit sandy bottoms in shallow coastal areas, burrow backwards to evade predators, and display cryptic behavior in their benthic habitats.
 
 
 
• Scientific Importance__
 
 
• The discovery enriches India’s marine taxonomy and demonstrates the use of molecular tools like CO1 gene sequencing in modern species identification.

questions.question: What is the name of Google’s 27-billion-parameter AI model that generated a novel hypothesis for cancer detection?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cell2Sentence-Scale 27B (C2S-Scale).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Google has unveiled Cell2Sentence-Scale 27B (C2S-Scale), a 27-billion-parameter AI foundation model that proposed a new drug combination for cancer detection, which human experts had not identified before.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **C2S-Scale is designed to understand the molecular and cellular “language” of individual cells, enabling it to identify patterns beyond human recognition.**
 
• **The AI model generated a novel hypothesis about how cancer cells behave, which was experimentally validated in living cells.**
 
• **The core research goal was to detect tumours before the immune system could recognize them, by inducing antigen presentation signals in early-stage cancer cells.**
 
• **The discovery demonstrates AI’s potential to go beyond data analysis and actively contribute to scientific breakthroughs in biomedical research.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Cell2Sentence-Scale 27B (C2S-Scale)__

 __
 
• Developed by Google to interpret and model cellular behavior using large-scale biological data.
 
• Contains 27 billion parameters, making it one of the most advanced biomedical AI models to date.
 
• Demonstrates AI’s role in hypothesis generation, not just computational analysis.
 
 
 
• Scientific Relevance__
 __
 
• Introduced a new approach for early tumour detection via immune-triggering antigen presentation.
 
• Experimental success suggests potential for new cancer therapy development pathways.
 
• Further pre-clinical and clinical trials are required to validate its therapeutic use.
 
 
 
• Broader Significance__
 
 
• Marks one of the rare instances where AI has directly contributed to new scientific discoveries.
 
• Positions Google as a leader in integrating AI and life sciences for healthcare innovation.
